root_cause.text: `smb_inherit_dacl()` trusts the on-disk `num_aces` value from a parent directory's DACL xattr without validating it against the actual DACL payload size, enabling an attacker with access to tamper the xattr to cause an oversized heap allocation and integer overflow, and also uses an insufficient minimum ACE size check in the walk loop.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states "smb_inherit_dacl() trusts the on-disk num_aces value ... without checking that it is consistent with the declared pdacl_size." The patch adds a validation check: `if (num_aces > aces_size / (offsetof(struct smb_ace, sid) + offsetof(struct smb_sid, sub_auth) + sizeof(__le16)))` and tightens the per-ACE loop guard to require `pace_size >= offsetof(struct smb_ace, sid) + CIFS_SID_BASE_SIZE`.
